newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Powerful quake rocks central Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Powerful quake rocks central Colombia.

text.p: A powerful earthquake rocked central Colombia on Thursday but there were no immediate reports of casualties or serious damage, authorities said.
German Escallon, director of the National Seismological Institute, told RCN radio the quake, measuring 5.3 on the Richter scale, occurred at 7:45 a.m. (1245 GMT).
Its epicentre was in Cumaral, a small town in Meta province in the foothills of the Cordillera Oriental mountains just southeast of the capital Bogota, Escallon said.
He added that apart from Bogota, the temblor had been felt in Villavicencio, capital of Meta, and in the jungle-covered southern province of Caqueta.
